citations.quote: Name: Rell. Official role tags: Tank, Support.
Rell becomes Dismounted and leaps to the target location, gaining a shield
pulling nearby enemies inward

core_mechanics.summary: Shielded leap and nearby pulls provide her engage pattern.

cards.purpose: Recognize Rell's role, engage pattern, damage and durability focus.
cards.title: Rell

citations.quote: All subsequent stacks will reduce the targets resistances based on the snapshotted amount, even if the target's total resistances change. This snapshot lasts until the debuff expires.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Resistance reduction uses a snapshot taken when the initial stack is applied.

citations.quote: Rell's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage on-hit equal to a percentage of her total armor and total magic resistance.

core_mechanics.summary: Attacks gain magic damage based on her resistances.

citations.quote: Rell's basic attacks and abilities apply a stack of Break The Mold to enemies hit for a few seconds. Each stack reduces the target's armor and magic resist and increases Rell's armor and magic resist by the same amount.

core_mechanics.summary: Attacks and abilities apply stacking resistance theft.

cards.purpose: Explain why extended contact changes both sides' durability.
cards.title: Break the Mold

citations.quote: Rell deals magic damage to units in a line, breaking their shields and stunning them.
destroys damage shields of enemies hit before dealing magic damage and stunning

core_mechanics.summary: Line strike destroys damage shields before its magic damage and stun.

cards.purpose: Recognize the linear stun and its shield-breaking threat.
cards.title: Shattering Strike

citations.quote: Upon completing a Recall channel or respawning, Rell will automatically revert to Mounted form without casting the ability and reset Ferromancy: Mount Up's cooldown.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Recall completion and respawn restore mounted form and reset Mount Up's cooldown.

citations.quote: Rell becomes Dismounted and leaps to the target location, gaining a shield that lasts until destroyed or casting Ferromancy: Mount Up. Upon arrival, she deals magic damage and briefly knocks up and stuns enemies hit.

core_mechanics.summary: Shielded dismounting leap damages and disables enemies on arrival.

citations.quote: She will continue sliding forward to affect further enemies along her path.

core_mechanics.summary: The slide extends the affected path beyond the landing.

citations.quote: Rell can cast Magnet Storm during the dash

core_mechanics.summary: Magnet Storm can be cast during the leap.

cards.purpose: Recognize the mounted area engage and its ultimate combination.
cards.title: Ferromancy: Crash Down

citations.quote: Rell can use the empowered attack even while grounded or rooted.
The dash can be knocked down but the attack's effects will still be applied.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Rooting, grounding or knocking down the charge does not necessarily prevent the empowered attack's effects.

citations.quote: While Rell is Dismounted, she gains 15% bonus armor, 15% bonus magic resistance, 20% bonus attack speed, and 75 bonus attack range.

core_mechanics.summary: Dismounted form grants resistances, attack speed and attack range.

citations.quote: Rell becomes Mounted and gains bonus movement speed for a short time
Rell's next basic attack will gain bonus attack range and causes her to charge to the target, dealing bonus magic damage before briefly stunning and flinging them over.

core_mechanics.summary: Remounting grants speed and an empowered charge attack that stuns and flings its target.

cards.purpose: Distinguish the dismounted defenses and remount attack from Crash Down.
cards.title: Ferromancy: Mount Up

citations.quote: Rell powers up herself and the target allied champion for 3 seconds, both gaining 15% bonus movement speed, increased to 30% while facing the empowered ally or a visible enemy champion.

core_mechanics.summary: Rell and an ally gain movement speed, enhanced toward the empowered ally or a visible enemy champion.

citations.quote: Rell's next basic attack or Shattering Strike within 5 seconds will also explode around the target, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.

core_mechanics.summary: The next attack or Shattering Strike triggers an area magic damage explosion.

cards.purpose: Recognize the shared approach speed and follow-up explosion.
cards.title: Full Tilt

citations.quote: Spell shield will block the initial pull but not the dragging effect.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Spell shields block the initial pull but do not block the ongoing drag.

citations.quote: Rell explodes in a magnetic fury, violently Pulling nearby enemies toward herself. Then Rell constantly Drags nearby enemies toward herself for a short while, dealing magic damage over time.

core_mechanics.summary: Initial nearby pull followed by ongoing drag and magic damage.

citations.quote: Kinematics drags enemies toward the Source, but does not disable their actions nor intercept other forms of movement.

core_mechanics.summary: The ongoing drag permits actions and other movement.

cards.purpose: Recognize the area pull and distinguish ongoing drag from a continuous disable.
cards.title: Magnet Storm

factual_risks: Important cooldown topic: the supplied evidence does not give ordinary ability cooldowns or establish the shared timing between Crash Down and Mount Up. Do not infer an immediate recast or a precise punish window.
The supplied Mount Up section marks player-made wall interactions as pending testing; these interactions are omitted.
The broad wiki:R excerpt includes unrelated lore and historical changes; these do not establish additional current mechanics.

citations.quote: While Rell is Dismounted, she can cast Ferromancy: Mount Up.
This ability can be cast only while Rell is Dismounted.
While Rell is Mounted, she can cast Ferromancy: Crash Down.
Rell's next basic attack or Shattering Strike within 5 seconds will also explode around the target, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.

relationships.condition: Shattering Strike triggers Full Tilt's pending explosion.

section_disposition.reason: Passive damage and resistance theft are taught; snapshot details remain advanced metadata.
Line stun and shield destruction are central enemy-recognition effects.
Mounted engage, shield, slide and ultimate combination are taught together.
The remount charge has a distinct recognition purpose; dismounted bonuses are merged into this card.
Shared movement speed and the conditional explosion are taught together.
Initial pull, ongoing drag and freedom to act are taught together.

summary: A compact overview and primary ability cards, with a distinct Mount Up variant card for the remount chase and displacement threat.
